source='''def transform(grid):
    """Recolor every solid, full-height or full-width line to marker 2."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(row) == w and row and all(x == row[0] for x in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h))]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in rows:
        out[i] = [2] * w
    for j in cols:
        for i in range(h):
            out[i][j] = 2
    return out
'''

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task37',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def getgrid(text,label,shape):
    start=text.index(label)+len(label)
    h,w=shape
    block=text[start:].strip().splitlines()[:h]
    grid=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in block]
    assert len(grid)==h and all(len(r)==w for r in grid),(label, len(grid),[len(r) for r in grid])
    return grid
for idx,shape in [(4,(21,28)),(8,(22,13))]:
    text=''.join(part.get('text','') for part in msgs[idx]['content'] if part.get('type')=='text')

    og=getgrid(text,'output ('+str(shape[0])+'x'+str(shape[1])+'):',shape)
    pred=mod.transform(ig)
